items.title: In the Age of AI, Cash Is Still King
items.summary: Savings accounts, short-term Treasury bills and money-market funds paid little yield when interest rates were near zero.  The Federal Reserve’s rate hikes starting in 2022 reset the bar for what cash could pay out to investors.  On top of that, the advance of technology and new forms of banking and money not only add new competitors for cash—neobanks, stablecoins, tokenized or exchange-traded Treasury bills—but make it increasingly easy to switch cash from where it earns little, to where it earns more.
